candidateEngine: Baseline loops relink at a back-edge: generic call sites whose targets repay a direct-call-target compile (or gained entry code) join the body's pending targets, the next back-edge polls, the VM compiles the targets and unlinks the body, and the poll resumes the interpreter at the loop header; OSR compiles count the triggering loop's trip count as target evidence; relinks are bounded per (caller, target) pair.

binarySha256.beforeDescription: previous gate build: back-edge relink limited to one relink per function

runOrder: Per script and mode: pairs 1 and 3 before->after, pair 2 after->before; one process per run; no builds, tests or agents ran; load average about 2.4.
aggregation: Geometric mean of after/before ratios of in-script wall milliseconds, process instructions and cycles across three pairs.
